inputs.text: Organizers claim 8 million people attended “No Kings” protests at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states, but authorities have provided no official count. That’s a political claim from the organizers, not proof that the country has rejected its elected president. The protests may be loud and widespread, but staging demonstrations against Trump is not the same as winning public consent. The organizers say turnout exceeded October’s protests by about one million people and 600 events; they clearly want that comparison to read as a national mandate. It isn’t one.
